items.title: What Could Seagate Technology Holdings (STX) Gain From The New US Memory Policy?
items.summary: Seagate Technology Holdings (NasdaqGS: STX) is in focus after a recent US policy shift aimed at discouraging domestic tech companies from buying conventional memory chips from Chinese suppliers. The policy change has supported a rally in US based memory and storage chipmakers as investors reassess the competitive outlook for these companies. items.title: Why Sandisk Stock Is Getting Its Mojo Back
items.summary: Sandisk  stock is on a hot streak and may finally be getting its mojo back.  The shares are on a five-day winning streak through Friday, jumping 35% in that time.  Sandisk was moving in tandem with other memory stocks, including  Western Digital Seagate  and  Micron  Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick urging Apple not to buy memory chips from China, may be helping matters.

items.title: 3 Reasons We Love Seagate (STX)
